bibl.title: Tunics Worn in Egypt in Roman and Byzantine Times: The Greek Vocabulary.
bibl.seg: Maria Mossakowska-Gaubert, Tunics Worn in Egypt in Roman and Byzantine Times: The Greek Vocabulary.

Salvatore Gaspa, Cécile Michel & Marie-Louise Nosch (edd.), Textile Terminologies from the Orient to the Mediterranean and Europe, 1000 BC to 1000 AD = Zea E-Books. 56 (Lincoln, Nebraska, 2017) pp. 321-345, figg.
bibl.note: δαλματική / δελματική / δελματικίον. - καμίσιον, ὑποκαμίσιον (καμάσον, καμάσιον, camisa, camisia). - κολόβιον. - λεβίτων (λεβήτων, λεβητωνάριον, λεβητονάριον, λεβιτωνάριον). - στιχάριον. - χιτών (χιθών, χιτώνιον, κιθών, κιτώνιον). - Words derived from terms designating tunics. - Words composed with the term μαφόριον. - Other composite terms. - Conclusion.
